code: jecfa_sample <- c(1, 10, 11) |>   purrr::map(\(id) compose_jecfa_list(id) |> get_result()) |>   create_df() |>   process_df() |>   add_metadata()  trs_urls_list <- jecfa_sample |>   compose_urls() |>   remove_null_urls() #> Warning: Condition not satisfied, skipping...  trs_urls <- trs_urls_list |>   purrr::map_chr("url")  out_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "trs") dir.create(out_dir) trs_paths <- trs_urls_list |>   compose_filepaths(out_dir)  out_dir_noid <- file.path(tempdir(), "trs_noid") dir.create(out_dir_noid) trs_paths_noid <- trs_urls_list |>   compose_filepaths(out_dir_noid, noid = TRUE)  if (FALSE) { # this would actually download the data   download_trs(trs_urls[[1]], trs_paths[[1]], trs_paths_noid[[1]])   fs::dir_ls(out_dir)   fs::dir_ls(out_dir_noid) }
